reason: Exact-symbol priority recovers two direct-target notes under capacity pressure, but four irrelevant direct-symbol notes displace a relevant callee note. The no-loss acceptance criterion fails despite higher aggregate recall.

plan.hypothesis: Stable exact-symbol priority before the four-memory cap improves selection while keeping dependency candidates eligible.
acceptance: All calls and integration tests pass.
No previously recovered relevant memory is lost on any of the three corpora.
At least one capacity-pressure query gains a relevant memory; aggregate precision does not decline.
Off/counted membership and metrics remain unchanged across builds; counted preserves off packet content.
Stale links remain excluded, memory lift cap remains four, ambiguity/prose preserve fallback.
plan.policy: Do not tune labels or ranking after observing outcomes. Revert production trial if acceptance fails.
